question: Select the wrongly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e.**'Anonyomus'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** wrongly** spelt word is: **'Anonyomus'**
 
• The **correct spelling** is **"Anonymous"** which means not identified by name; of unknown name.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Anonyomus'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of the words:
 
 
• **Adulation **- This word is correctly spelled. "Adulation" means excessive admiration or praise.(अतिस्तुति)
 
• **Perfidious **- This word is correctly spelled. "Perfidious" means deceitful and untrustworthy. (विश्वासघाती)
 
• **Circuitous **- This word is correctly spelled. "Circuitous" means (of a route or journey) longer than the most direct way.(घुमावदार)
